knownProductionGaps.detail: Password-forgot and password-reset routes remain explicitly planned rather than falsely marked implemented.
Current rate limits are process-local. Local 429 behavior is covered, but a shared production limiter is required for multi-instance deployment.
Several advertising, community, and provider repository reads still load broad result sets before in-memory filtering/slicing; production-scale pagination and explain evidence remain required.
The isolated 27018 and 27019 instances are single-node replica sets for local transaction/bootstrap checks, not a highly available production cluster; 27017 standalone was preserved untouched.
Production SMTP, private storage, malware scanning, monitoring, native Ubuntu services, backup/restore, and production credentials were not claimed or exercised.
Email-only authentication is enforced, while the identity model retains a normalized phone field/index used by contact/business data; migration policy must be confirmed before production rollout.
